name: bg-title
prompt: Generate an image. The first attached picture shows five characters from my party game Kitchen Kaiju (tiny monsters made of food); the second shows ONIGORI up close. In front of it the five kaiju pose heroically with giant cutlery, EACH APPEARING EXACTLY ONCE and matching its reference design and colours, left to right: the pink STRAWBERRY lizard holding a giant fork, the pink bubblegum ELEPHANT holding a giant spoon, the cream DUMPLING kaiju with chopsticks, the PIZZA RAPTOR holding a big knife, and the small CUTE baby ONIGIRI rice-ball gorilla (rounded-triangle rice head, big friendly eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny red plum on its forehead, black nori shorts) holding a salt shaker. Landscape 16:9.
